Complies with Intel® Power Design Guide ATX 3.1

FSP MEGA PM series is compatible with the latest ATX 3.1 regulation to support up to 200% power excursion and with the latest interface of PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to ensure peak performance with future hardware upgrades.
( Micro Tolerance Load Control) Load Regulation ±1%

( Micro Tolerance Load Control ) is an advanced design that enables processors and graphics cards to perform high-speed AI calculations efficiently, minimizing delays caused by power surges or sudden load changes. With superior load regulation of just 1%, exceeding the Intel ATX 3.1 standard, this advanced design achieves stable voltage delivery, enhances power supply efficiency, and improves the performance and reliability of sensitive electronic devices.
This precise control reduces power consumption, heat generation, and voltage fluctuations, ultimately extending the lifespan of both the power supply and the devices it powers.
Platinum certification for lower power loss, less heat, and quieter operation.
Infineon CoolMOS™ Superjunction + CoolSiC™ Silicon Carbide Technology

Equipped with the latest-generation Infineon CoolMOS™ superjunction MOSFETs and CoolSiC™ silicon-carbide Schottky diodes, this power supply achieves class-leading efficiency exceeding 92%, virtually eliminates reverse-recovery losses, offers ultra-low RDS(on), and comfortably supports switching frequencies above 100 kHz. The result is a dramatically smaller, lighter, and cooler design with significantly reduced EMI and fan noise, all while delivering proven 175 °C thermal robustness and exceptional long-term reliability that keeps your system stable for years to come.
Under 50% loading, you will enjoy Zero RPM experience when semi-fanless fan control switch is on, and get the benefit of long lifespan from a 135mm fluid dynamic bearing fan.
PCIe 8 Pin connectors and 12V-2x6 connectors offer flexible configuration for even the most power-hungry NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards.
To make power supply installation easy and allows users to use only the needed cables, improving airflow and reducing system clutter.
Covered with exclusive conformal coating which guarantees to offer better and reliable performance in harsh environments and is tested to work in environments up to 95% relative humidity.
It’s an ideal size for compact PC or space-constraint environment without compromising on performance.
Maximize reliability and performance by using top-quality Japanese electrolytic capacitors for a longer lifespan.

Modern CPUs and graphics cards can draw significant amounts of power, especially during peak loads, a single +12V rail PSU offers a good balance of simplicity, power delivery capability, and stability.
